about: Removal cases seen from two or three panoramas each, to compare the results across views. Each view is edited on its own: nothing makes the views agree. The exterior cases edit the house itself and are odd on purpose (a window, the garage door). Each view is rendered from a downloaded scan under data/ (git-ignored), so this file holds no pictures. Run with: python -m edit_agent.suite cases/multiview.json. One picture per case: python -m edit_agent.stages --suite <table>.json.

cases.name: interior-coffee-table
cases.request: remove the coffee table and everything on it
cases.notes: Living room, near world x -1.2, y -6.5. A glass and mirror table with a tray and a vase on it, standing on a yellow patterned rug. The rug's pattern under the table has to be invented, so the views can disagree there. Panorama 7 sees it from the kitchen, 5.4 m away.

cases.name: interior-dresser
cases.request: remove the dresser and everything on it
cases.notes: Bedroom, near world x 0.9, y -6.3. A dark wood dresser with a lit lamp and three vases on it, against a white wall with a baseboard, under a wall hanging that must stay. Panorama 2 stands 1.7 m from it.

cases.name: exterior-window
cases.notes: The front window, near world x -6.0, y -2.3, with plants in front of its lower edge and the house numbers and a sign on the pillar next to it. Odd on purpose: the wall has to close up.

cases.name: exterior-garage-door
cases.notes: The white double garage door at the end of the driveway. Odd on purpose: the request does not say what should be there instead, and the door fills much of the view, so the paste area is most of the picture.
